question: The compound 'X' is produced when baking soda is heated. Recrystallization of X gives compound 'Y'. Select the compounds X and Y, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sodium carbonate and washing soda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sodium carbonate**

 
 
• **Baking soda**, which is also called **sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3)**, is a chemical that can break down when heated.
 
• **Sodium bicarbonate** begins to breakdown into **sodium carbonate (Na2CO3)**, **water (H2O)**, and **carbon dioxide (CO2)** at temperatures above **176 °F (80 °C)**
 
• The **sodium bicarbonate** will decompose at a quicker rate the higher the temperature that it is exposed to. 
 
• As a solid product, nothing except **sodium carbonate** will be left over.
 
• Because **carbon dioxide** and **water** both become gaseous when exposed to heated temperatures, this indicates that they will disappear into the air around them.
 
 
 
• **Washing soda**
 
 
• The production of **washing soda** involves the **recrystallization of sodium carbonate**.
 
• **​Washing soda** is a powder that is white in color and odorless.
 
• **Sodium carbonate decahydrate** is a more common name for this substance, which has the chemical formula **Na2CO3.10H2O**.
 
• It is capable of drawing moisture from the surrounding air due to its **hygroscopic nature**.
 
• It has a high solubility in water and produces a very alkaline solution when dissolved in it.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uses of Sodium carbonate**

 
 
• **​**It is used to make **soaps, detergents, and paper**.
 
• It is utilized as a wetting agent in the brick manufacturing sector.
 
• It is used to soften hard water, which contains magnesium and calcium. Carbonate causes ion precipitation.
 
• It is utilized to modify **pH**.
 
• In toothpaste, it serves as an abrasive and foaming agent.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Sodium bicarbonate**
 
 
• **​**Baking soda (**sodium bicarbonate**) can help with acid indigestion, sour stomach, and heartburn by acting as an acid neutralizer.
 
• When used in this way, the medication is classified as an** antacid**.
 
• In some cases, it is used to reduce the discomfort associated with duodenal or stomach ulcers.
 
• Alkalizing the blood and urine with sodium bicarbonate is a common practice in some medical situations.
 
 
 
• **Uses of Washing soda****​**
 
 
• It is a reagent that is used in the **laboratory**.
 
• It is utilized in the process of **eliminating stains**.
 
• It is put to use in the process of eliminating the water's inherent hardness.
 
• Washing soda is used in the production of soap, paper, and glass, among other things.
 
• In addition to that, it has applications in the textile and petroleum refining industries.
 
 
 
• **Uses of bleaching powder**
 
 
• **​**It is a strong oxidizer, so many industries use it as an oxidizer.
 
• It is used as a disinfectant to clean water so that it is safe to drink.
 
• It is used in the laundry to bleach dirty clothes and in the textile industry to bleach cotton and linen.
